display_name: Regular 2D Grid to Triangle Mesh Converter
description: Convert a regular 2D grid to a triangle mesh using a cell-centered or vertex-centered scalar attribute as Z values. Supports optional NaN filtering.

drop_nan_patches.description: Exclude triangles that touch NaN attribute values
drop_nan_patches.title: Drop Nan Patches

triMeshVersion.description: Triangle mesh schema version for output payload. Use 2.1 for Oasis Montaj compatibility or 2.2 for latest schema.
triMeshVersion.title: Trimeshversion

use_centroids.description: Add a centroid vertex to each quad and split into 4 triangles instead of 2, producing a smoother surface at the cost of twice as many triangles
use_centroids.title: Use Centroids

attribute.description: Scalar attribute to use as Z values for the triangle mesh
attribute.title: Attribute

object.description: Input regular 2D grid containing the scalar attribute to use as Z values
object.title: Object

target.description: Where to create the output Triangle Mesh object

description.description: Description to put into the target object.
description.title: Description

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite the existing object.
overwrite.title: Overwrite

tags.description: Tags to put into the target object.
tags.title: Tags

target.title: Target

has_nan.description: True if the source attribute contains NaN values.
has_nan.title: Has Nan

is_rotated.description: True if the source grid has a non-identity rotation.
is_rotated.title: Is Rotated

nan_count.description: Number of NaN values in the source attribute.
nan_count.title: Nan Count

output.description: Reference to the created Triangle Mesh object.

description.description: The description of the geoscience object.
description.title: Description

name.description: The name of the geoscience object.
name.title: Name

schema_id.description: The ID of the Geoscience Object schema.
schema_id.title: Schema ID

output.title: Output Triangle Mesh

summary.description: Summary statistics for the generated triangle mesh.

has_non_manifold_edges.description: Always false — splitting a regular grid into triangles cannot produce edges shared by more than 2 triangles
has_non_manifold_edges.title: Has Non Manifold Edges

has_unused_vertices.description: Whether the mesh has orphan vertices not referenced by any triangle
has_unused_vertices.title: Has Unused Vertices

num_triangles.description: Number of triangles in the generated mesh
num_triangles.title: Num Triangles

num_vertices.description: Number of vertices in the mesh vertex array
num_vertices.title: Num Vertices

summary.title: Summary
